name: Taj Mahal
description: The iconic white marble mausoleum and symbol of eternal love, renowned worldwide for its stunning architecture and intricate craftsmanship.

name: Agra Fort
description: A massive red sandstone fort with beautiful palaces, halls, and mosques, offering panoramic views of the Taj Mahal across the Yamuna River.

name: Mehtab Bagh
description: A serene garden complex perfectly aligned with the Taj Mahal, ideal for sunset views and peaceful walks along the Yamuna River.

name: Itimad-ud-Daulah's Tomb
description: Often called the 'Baby Taj', this exquisite marble mausoleum is known for its delicate pietra dura inlay work and beautiful gardens.

name: Jama Masjid
description: A grand mosque built by Shah Jahan with impressive architecture and a peaceful courtyard, still active for prayers.

name: Kinari Bazaar
description: A bustling traditional market famous for its vibrant fabrics, jewelry, handicrafts, and local street food experiences.

name: Mankameshwar Temple
description: An ancient Shiva temple known for its spiritual ambiance and intricate carvings, attracting devotees and tourists alike.

name: Chini Ka Rauza
description: A unique funerary monument decorated with glazed tiles, showcasing Persian architectural influence and vibrant colors.

name: Taj Nature Walk
description: A tranquil nature trail near the Taj Mahal offering birdwatching opportunities and a refreshing escape from the city bustle.

name: Ram Bagh
description: The oldest Mughal garden in India, featuring lush greenery, fountains, and historical pavilions perfect for a leisurely stroll.

name: Fatehpur Sikri
description: A UNESCO World Heritage site and former Mughal capital, known for its stunning red sandstone palaces, mosques, and courtyards.

name: Mariyam's Tomb
description: A lesser-known tomb dedicated to Mariam-uz-Zamani, showcasing beautiful Mughal architecture and peaceful surroundings.

name: Sadar Bazaar
description: A lively market area offering a wide range of souvenirs, leather goods, handicrafts, and authentic Mughlai cuisine.

name: Jama Masjid (Shah Jahan's)
description: A majestic mosque built by Shah Jahan, featuring grand architecture and a serene prayer hall.

name: Scindia Museum
description: A museum housed in a former palace, showcasing artifacts, paintings, and memorabilia from the Scindia dynasty.

name: Mughal Heritage Walk
description: A guided walking tour exploring the rich Mughal history, architecture, and local life around the Taj Mahal and Agra Fort.

name: Kalakriti Cultural & Convention Center
description: Home to the famous Mohabbat The Taj show, this center offers cultural performances and exhibitions celebrating Agra's heritage.

name: Dayal Bagh
description: A spiritual community and garden complex known for its peaceful environment, beautiful architecture, and social harmony.

name: Jama Masjid (Old Agra)
description: One of the oldest mosques in Agra, featuring traditional Mughal architecture and a vibrant local atmosphere.

name: Taj Museum
description: Located near the Taj Mahal, this museum displays artifacts, models, and historical information about the monument and Mughal era.

name: Ram Bagh Palace
description: A historic palace within Ram Bagh garden, showcasing Mughal architecture and offering a glimpse into royal life.
